title: Bolsheviktion 2: Yurovsky's Revenge
description:
StoryRussia, 1920. Two years after the carnage you unleashed upon the communist regime in Bolsheviktion 3D, your marriage to the princess has produced a beautiful baby boy.

One stormy night, your son’s screams shatter your peaceful life. You find a ransom note, a trace of blood—and an empty crib.

You grab your pistol from the closet and give chase.

Your son needs you.

Features• Four epic acts. 16 sprawling Levels. 4 Secret Levels — From the comforts of Alexander Palace to the blood-stained tunnels of the gulags and the industrial heartland of post-revolutionary Russia, hunt your son’s captors without mercy—and kill any Bolshevik who gets in your way.

• Expanded Enemy roster — Face nine distinct enemy types and four brutal end-of-act bosses—from dim-witted Brownshirts to the ferocious Black Guard and heavily armoured flamethrower troops.

• Three new weapons — The four classic Bolsheviktion 3D weapons return, joined by the C96 pistol, a double-barrelled shotgun and a flamethrower for roasting Bolsheviks.

• Four difficulty modes — Choose from Give Me a Go, Dad, Don’t Be So Tough and Let’s Go, Boys!—easy, medium and hard.

Think you’re a professional? BOLSHEVIKTOR! mode awaits, and it is not even remotely fair.

• Rubles & Collectibles — Loot Bolshevik treasure and recover your son’s missing heirlooms. Spend your hard-earned rubles building a library of forbidden anti-Bolshevik books, each granting a powerful in-game perk.

• Smarter, Meaner Secrets — Wolfenstein-style pushwalls are only the beginning. Search for fake walls, hidden switches, pressure plates and rising or lowering platforms.

• 31-track original soundtrack - specially composed to match every level of the campaign, all in glorious MIDI.

• Supercharged Retro Raycasting Engine — Built from the ground up in pure C, classic raycasting is massively expanded with true height variation, multi-level texture-mapped floors and ceilings, dynamic lighting, colour grading, skyboxes, animated textures and moving objects — all rendered in software.
description_short: Whites in chaos. A kidnapped royal son. One man to save the Empire. In this explosive standalone sequel to Bolsheviktion 3D, pursue your son’s kidnappers across war-torn Russia through four action-packed acts, blasting Bolsheviks to an original MIDI soundtrack with chunky pixel graphics!
